processes.name: sensor node
processes.description: A deployed sensor node that publishes readings, polls for firmware updates, installs firmware, and is serviced through a local serial console.

processes.name: device gateway
processes.description: An MQTT broker that accepts readings from sensor nodes and forwards them to Pub/Sub.

processes.name: telemetry normalizer
processes.description: A Python consumer that picks up readings from Pub/Sub and writes them into the telemetry lake.

processes.name: dashboard
processes.description: A dashboard used by fleet operators to view telemetry over BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery
processes.notes: The source uses the plural form 'dashboards'.

data_stores.description: A Firestore registry used to check a node's key and determine which customer it belongs to.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to

data_stores.name: telemetry lake
data_stores.description: A BigQuery data store containing readings, site addresses, and occupancy patterns.

data_stores.name: firmware bucket
data_stores.description: A Cloud Storage bucket from which sensor nodes poll firmware images.
data_stores.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image
data_stores.notes: The bucket is public read. The source does not state whether nodes check an image signature before installing it.

assumptions.assumption: The sensor node presents a non-web interface because it publishes over MQTT and is serviced over a serial console.
assumptions.basis: The source describes MQTT publishing and a local serial console, neither of which is a web application interface.

assumptions.assumption: The device gateway presents a non-web interface because it is an MQTT broker.
assumptions.basis: The source explicitly identifies the gateway as an MQTT broker.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry normalizer presents a non-web interface because it is a Python consumer.
assumptions.basis: The source describes it as a consumer rather than a web application.

assumptions.assumption: The dashboard presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: A dashboard viewed by operators is treated as a web-facing application interface.

assumptions.assumption: The sensor node holds credentials because it authenticates to the broker with a pre-shared key.
assumptions.basis: The source states that nodes authenticate with a pre-shared key.

assumptions.assumption: The sensor node handles personal data because its readings are associated with deployed customer devices.
assumptions.basis: The source describes customer-site sensor readings, and the asset vocabulary treats a reading tied to a device as PII.

assumptions.assumption: The device gateway handles credentials and personal data.
assumptions.basis: It checks the authentication key and forwards sensor readings.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry normalizer handles personal data.
assumptions.basis: It picks up sensor readings and writes them into the telemetry lake, which contains customer data.

assumptions.assumption: The dashboard handles personal data.
assumptions.basis: It displays data queried from the telemetry lake, which contains customer data.

assumptions.assumption: The device registry is confidential because it contains authentication keys and customer associations.
assumptions.basis: The source says the registry is used to check the key and determine which customer a node belongs to.

assumptions.assumption: Pub/Sub is confidential because it carries customer sensor readings.
assumptions.basis: The source states that accepted readings are forwarded onto Pub/Sub, and the resulting lake contains customer data.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry lake is confidential because it contains site addresses and occupancy patterns that are customer data.
assumptions.basis: The source explicitly says the lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns and calls them customer data.

assumptions.assumption: The firmware bucket is public because the source states that it is public read.
assumptions.basis: The source explicitly states, 'The bucket is public read.'
